description: Returns one substance of the register: its forms with the share of the element where known, the upper limit of the country first, then the limits of other countries with type, source and the date checked, reference sources, and the number of published products that contain it.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the person. Limits of this country come first. Default US.

name.description: Substance name, e.g. "Vitamin D", as an alternative to id.

name: get_ingredient
title: Get ingredient
